dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear reduction in visible lateral width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey skin tone consistent with a sub-adult or juvenile phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, light-colored speckling and subtle mottling across the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary dark-grey tone and lighter speckled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent, high-contrast light-colored linear mark on the posterior dorsal plane; one small dark circular spot on the left cranial margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, longitudinal light-colored mark, consistent with a healed linear scar, is visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, well-defined dark circular mark is located on the upper-left dorsal margin, anterior to the mid-back.
